import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
def load_data(file_path):
    return pd.read_csv(file_path, names=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species'])

# Create the visualization
def create_visualization(data):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 6))
    
    sns.scatterplot(x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', hue='species', data=data, ax=ax[0])
    ax[0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width')
    ax[0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length')
    ax[0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width')
    ax[0].legend(title='Species')
    
    sns.scatterplot(x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', data=data, ax=ax[1])
    ax[1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width')
    ax[1].set_xlabel('Petal Length')
    ax[1].set_ylabel('Petal Width')
    ax[1].legend(title='Species')
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Main function
def main():
    file_path = 'data/iris.csv'
    data = load_data(file_path)
    create_visualization(data)

    main()
